description:
FOUND by s543h (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22, the batch's bench leg legs/r2-bench.log: the whole box, load 1.0-1.4, best of 2, base = bcf25a90 = main 00b75ac5 + s543g, tree = s543h a8889369).

MEASURED (scratch/s543h/evalcompile.pl in the s543h worktree: one eval text compiled through `pl2cl --server`, the eval's first run):
  a 300-line eval text of 900 package globals, NO leading region      42.51 -> 42.38 s (-0.3 %)
  the SAME text behind a leading `package Foo;` (eval_pkg Foo)        42.87 -> 72.07 s (+68.1 %)
  a 30-line Sub::Quote-shaped text with a leading `package Foo;`       0.38 ->  0.39 s (+2.8 %)
The three largest corpus files transpile inside the budget (pack.t +0.8 %, signatures.t +6.2 %, sprintf2.t +1.1 %).

CAUSE: s543h member 3 (#2091) makes Parser2::_requalify_eval_text run the region requalifier (_requalify_region) over every eval text, and _requalify_region walks the statements once PER CANDIDATE NAME (900 names x 300 statements).  WIP 6 (Binder::homed_away) limits the candidates to the names some use homes away from the eval's package -- but only when the text has NO leading `package X;` region; with a region every name the text mentions is offered.

FIX DIRECTION (a prototype, NOT applied; patches in the s543h worktree scratch/s543h/x-try.patch-binder + x-try.patch-parser2, extraction scratch/s543h/x-try = 9b024238 + the two hunks): homed_away also returns a canon whose GLOBAL binding is homed outside the eval's package (`$k eq 'global' && perl_package ne $pkg`: a global inside a `package X;` region with X ne eval_pkg is exactly a name that can move), and _requalify_eval_text takes that filter with or without a region.  The binder's refs cover every spelling the requalifier reads (sym / arylen / brace / interp / interp-code / readline), so the filter can only drop a candidate whose every use the keep predicate would leave anyway.  Prototype checks (on a8889369 + the hunks): the probes p1/shapes p1/more1 p2/shapes p3/shapes p3/rows p3/extra p4/shapes p5/g1 p5/g6 and p6/region.pl print byte for byte what the tree prints.  The timing of the prototype is in the s543h STOP.md (legs/try-bench.log) if it was taken.

WHAT TO MEASURE when this is taken: evalcompile.pl base vs tree (the three rows), the wide A/B (must be SAME everywhere: the filter is emission-neutral by construction), the full gate.


=== PROTOTYPE MEASURED (s543h, 2026-11-22 22:25-22:32, legs/try-bench.log in the s543h worktree; the whole box, load 1.0-1.8; evalcompile.pl best of 2; A = the s543h tree 9b024238, B = x-try = 9b024238 + the two hunks) ===
  big_noregion  43.06 -> 43.18 s (+0.3 %)
  big_region    71.82 -> 41.66 s (-42.0 %: back to the pre-s543h base, 42.99 s in legs/r3-bench.log)
  quote_region   0.39 ->  0.38 s (-1.7 %)
The emitted eval unit of all three texts is BYTE-IDENTICAL between A and B (cmp).  On a8889369 + the same hunks, the probe files p1/shapes p1/more1 p2/shapes p3/shapes p3/rows p3/extra p4/shapes p5/g1 p5/g6 and p6/region.pl printed exactly what the tree printed.  NOT applied (a code move after the stacking sha); whether it is taken is decided in the next brief.

=== DONE (s543k) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22/23; WIP 7)
s543h's prototype taken verbatim: Binder::homed_away's global arm; Parser2::_requalify_eval_text filters candidates with or without a leading region.  Emission identical: 12 eval texts x 3 site shapes compiled by WIP 6 and WIP 7, 36 byte-identical (scratch/s543k/tools/evalcmp.pl); s543h's 16 probe programs print identically.  Timing: the s543k bench leg (session log).
Timing (s543k resumed, 2026-11-24 20:36-20:40, the exclusive bench leg scratch/s543k/legs/F-bench.log, load 1.6-1.9; base = the extraction of cbcc9165 = MAIN-READY-109, tree = s543k 3851af89 = fa360e2b's code; ONE first-run compile per side, the HEAVY SLOTS (6) rule for a row over 30 s): the 300-line text of 900 globals behind a leading `package Foo;` 83.51 s -> 45.89 s (-45.0 %); the same text without the region 46.42 -> 46.27 s (-0.3 %); emission identical in both; the 30-line Sub::Quote-shaped region text 0.41 -> 0.44 s (best of 3, +0.03 s).  The region text now compiles as fast as the region-less one: the +68 % of s543h is gone.


=== CLOSED (the reviewing session, 2026-11-24) === merged as MAIN-READY-110 26d0dac4 (s543k); the full gate on merged main 380 files / 12,490 rows PASS; the review probes 18 of 18 = perl (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1122/rk, leg-1124.log); no baseline row is keyed on this task.
